text:
Sam: Quick heads up — HelixCorp pushed back on the MSA signature path. They want the Order Form signed by the US billing entity but the MSA executed by their EU subsidiary. They also want POC usage carved out of SLA credits. Any legal/procurement blockers?
Mike: FYI the POC runs on Dedicated capacity so usage is traceable. Split-signing is doable but we need to map tenant IDs to billing entity. Also need confirmation: will customer host KMS/HSM or expect Redwood KMS?
Tara: From procurement side we can support split-sign but we require the billing entity EIN/VAT on the OF. If MSA is with EU entity and OF with US entity we need an intercompany memo or explicit recital tying docs. @Jess any objection to a recital linking the two?
Jess: We can do a time-limited trial carveout (not indefinite). Suggested language (we can iterate):
```
Trial Usage Exclusion: For the initial sixty (60) days following the Effective Date, usage attributable solely to the Parties’ agreed proof-of-concept shall be excluded from calculations for SLA credits and remedies. Such exclusion terminates upon Go-Live or at the end of the 60-day period, whichever occurs first.
```
This keeps exposure bounded.
Nina: Security note — if the EU subsidiary signs the MSA, data transfer rules apply. We need a signed DPA + SCCs. Also they mentioned HSM-backed keys for some workloads — will require KMS integration questions.
Oliver: Finance note — we cannot invoice a US entity on the basis of an EU-signed MSA without clear billing instructions. If they want cross-entity billing, we need a PO referencing the Invoice Party and intercompany billing terms. Also VAT handling needs VAT number.
Sam: Customer insists no SLA credits for the POC period — offered 60 days is probably fine. They want to eSign via DocuSign but across two entities. Can we do two envelopes without breaking audit ties between docs?
Jess: Two envelopes are okay operationally but prefer one envelope containing both the MSA and a separately-signed Order Form to keep the audit trail contiguous. If they insist on separate envelopes, add an explicit recital in each doc linking them, e.g.:
"This Order Form is entered into pursuant to and subject to the Master Services Agreement between Parties dated [date], MSA Ref: HELIX-2026-MSA."
Mike: Technical follow-up: we'll tag all POC tokens and logs with tenant_id for clear attribution (example: tenant_id=helix-123). Please add a tenant_id and billing_entity field to the OF template so usage and billing line up.
Tara: I'll gather the billing entity legal name, EIN and VAT from Helix procurement. Jess — can you draft the trial carveout + recital? If you can, I'll route to Helix procurement once ready.
Jess: On it. I'll draft the carveout and recital now and post in legal-review thread. ETA ~2 hours. @Sam please confirm customer timezone is EET so we sync handoffs.
Sam: Confirmed, Helix procurement is EET. Also asked whether SLA credits only apply to production endpoints — clarify we don't apply credits for POC/test endpoints. Please call that out in the recital.
Nina: Also adding security ask: when the EU entity signs, deploy DPA with SCCs and confirm whether they need Redwood-managed keys or bring-your-own-key (BYOK). If BYOK/HSM, we need onboarding lead time.
deploy-bot: Document 'MSA-HelixCorp-v1-draft.docx' uploaded to /legal/drafts by Jess.
Sam: Plan of action: @Jess draft recital + 60-day trial carveout, @Tara collect billing EIN/VAT and confirm signers, @Mike update OF template with tenant_id and billing_entity, @Nina send DPA+SCC checklist. I'll update Helix once Jess posts the draft. :thumbsup:
